title: Distinct flattened partitions avoiding a pattern of length four
summary: Let $\mathcal{P}_n$ denote the set of distinct permutations of length $n$ that arise from the flattening process applied to the partitions of $[n]=\{1,\ldots,n\}$. In this paper, we consider the problem of avoidance of a single classical pattern of length four by members of $\mathcal{P}_n$. Let $p_n(τ)$ denote the number of members of $\mathcal{P}_n$ that avoid the pattern $τ$. We show that $p_n(τ)=C_{n-1}$ for all $n \geq 1$ for seven patterns of length four yielding new combinatorial interpretations of the Catalan number sequence.
